summary: Iteration 8 retest AFTER :where() CSS specificity fix for .btn-gold/.btn-navy/.btn-ghost/.btn-ghost-light. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest pass (health, POST enquiry valid, 2x 422 invalid, list). FRONTEND: mobile nav-cta bug from iteration 7 is FIXED — at 390x844 getComputedStyle([data-testid=nav-cta]).display === 'none' and bounding rect width === 0. Header on mobile correctly shows only logo (flex, width 48.7) + hamburger (flex, width 40). Sticky top:0, bg rgb(10,15,26), zIndex 50. Tablet 768: nav-cta visible (display: flex, width 114), toggle hidden. Desktop 1440: all 4 nav-link-* visible, nav-phone visible (display: flex), nav-cta visible amber. Header renders identically across /, /about, /services, /contact (rgb(10,15,26), top 0, cta visible). Services tiles: NO duplicate data-testids on either desktop or mobile. Desktop panels use service-tile-{slug}, mobile accordions use service-tile-{slug}-mobile (verified for new-home-builds, home-renovations, bathroom-renovations, kitchen-renovations). Button gold regression: nav-cta, hero-cta, final-cta-btn all computed bg rgb(197,137,45) = #C5892D (Apollo signature amber). Contact form end-to-end submission works: filled all 6 fields, submit-enquiry click produced [data-testid=thanks] element with 'Thank you — we'll be in touch soon' + toast 'Enquiry sent. We'll be in touch shortly.'. All spec assertions from review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: On tablet 768, nav-cta computes display: 'flex' rather than 'inline-flex' — cosmetic only, button still renders correctly with correct width. Tailwind's md:inline-flex utility appears to be applied but computed style shows 'flex' (possibly because the parent's flexbox layout treats them equivalently). No visual/functional impact.

nav-cta text color is rgb(244,241,234) (paper/off-white) on gold background — contrast ratio ~2.7:1 which is BELOW WCAG AA 4.5:1 threshold for small text. Consider using --ink-black (rgb(10,15,26)) for text on gold buttons per .btn-gold's default `color: var(--ink-black)` — however the applied class is overriding with paper text via inherited color from parent. Verify color inheritance chain on hero-cta/nav-cta buttons for accessibility.
seed_data_creation: One additional TEST_ enquiry created via UI form submission + backend pytest TEST_ enquiries
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview at https://premium-apollo.preview.emergentagent.com is healthy. The :where(.btn-gold) CSS specificity fix in /app/frontend/src/index.css works correctly — Tailwind .hidden utility now properly overrides. Mobile ENQUIRE button is no longer visible on <768px viewports. All service tile testids are unique on both desktop and mobile (mobile uses -mobile suffix). Contact form submission works end-to-end and shows thanks state.
rca of the issue: Iteration 7 bug (mobile ENQUIRE visible) was caused by .btn-gold's `display: inline-flex` at (0,1,0) specificity matching Tailwind's .hidden and winning due to import order. Fix in iteration 8 wrapped .btn-gold (and .btn-navy/.btn-ghost/.btn-ghost-light) in :where() which reduces specificity to (0,0,0), letting Tailwind's .hidden utility win the cascade. Verified via getComputedStyle at 390px: nav-cta display === 'none'.
